name: Strahd, the Mage
biography:
Phase rules: Each phase has an independent 331 hit point pool. When a phase reaches 0 hit points, replace it with another phase of your choice and end all conditions affecting Strahd. By default, the order is Mage, Soldier, Vampire. A phase reduced to 0 hit points cannot be used again until Strahd completes a long rest in his coffin. If all phases reach 0 hit points, Strahd becomes an immune-to-damage mist (except sunlight) unless he is in running water or sunlight; he must reach his coffin within 2 hours or be destroyed. In his coffin, he reverts to Vampire form, is paralyzed until he regains hit points, and regains 1 hit point after 1 hour.

Shared traits: Strahd does not require air. He cannot enter a residence without an occupant's invitation. He cannot gain the benefits of a long rest except by resting in his coffin for 8 consecutive hours between dawn and dusk. He can communicate with Barovian bats, rats, and wolves, which obey his commands. If a wooden piercing weapon is driven into his heart while he is incapacitated in his coffin, he is paralyzed until the stake is removed. While he retains the Fanes, Mountain grants permanent nondetection; Swamp lets him cast major image and move earth without components; Forest lets him cast beast sense and locate creature without components. If destroyed while retaining at least one Fane, he regains a new body in his coffin after 24 hours with all hit points and phases restored.

Source block lists passive Perception 24, although Perception +16 implies passive 26. The Foundry skill calculation displays +16; verify the passive value at the table.

items.name: Close Quarters Fighter
items.description: Strahd does not have disadvantage on his ranged attack rolls when within 5 feet of a hostile creature.

items.name: Complex Casting
items.description: If Strahd casts a spell on his turn using a bonus action, he can also use his action to cast a leveled spell on the same turn.

items.name: Regeneration
items.description: Strahd regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point and is not in sunlight. If he takes radiant damage, this trait does not function at the start of his next turn.

items.name: Spider Climb
items.description: Strahd can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving his hands free.

items.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
items.description: While in sunlight, Strahd takes 20 radiant damage at the start of his turn and has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

items.name: Fast Grappler
items.description: Strahd does not have to spend extra movement to move a creature grappled by him if the creature is the same size or smaller.

items.name: Innate Spellcasting
items.description: Intelligence is Strahd's innate spellcasting ability. He can cast detect thoughts and animate dead 3/day each, and scrying 1/day.

items.name: Multiattack
items.description: Strahd uses vampiric touch twice, or vampiric touch and telekinetic grasp once each.

items.name: Vampiric Touch
items.description: Strahd casts or attacks with vampiric touch (+12 to hit). A creature hit by an attack made with this spell must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be dazed until the start of Strahd's next turn. A dazed creature can move or take one action on its turn, not both, and cannot take a bonus action or reaction.

items.name: Telekinetic Grasp
items.description: 2nd-level transmutation, range 60 feet, components V, S, M, casting time 1 round. Strahd forces one creature he can see within 60 feet to make a DC 20 Strength saving throw. On a failure, it rises up to 20 feet, remains suspended until the start of Strahd's next turn, takes 7 (2d6) necrotic damage, and is restrained until the end of Strahd's next turn. When the effect ends, it falls if still aloft.

items.name: Circle of Sickness
items.description: 3rd-level necromancy, self, instantaneous. Each creature within 10 feet makes a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it takes 28 (8d6) necrotic damage and has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and suffers no disadvantage.

items.name: Multiple Reactions
items.description: Strahd can take up to three reactions per round, but only one per turn. If an effect or condition would prevent him from taking reactions, he loses one reaction instead.

items.name: Indomitable
items.description: Trigger: A hostile creature ends its turn. Strahd repeats the saving throw against one effect or condition currently affecting him. This has no effect if the effect did not originally require a failed saving throw.

items.name: Misty Step
items.description: In response to taking damage, Strahd casts misty step.

items.name: Blindness/Deafness
items.description: In response to taking damage from a melee attack, Strahd casts blindness/deafness (DC 20) against the attacker. A creature that fails its saving throw takes an additional 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

items.name: Control Water (Swamp Fane)
items.description: At initiative count 20 outdoors, while the Swamp Fane has not been reconsecrated, Strahd casts or uses control water without components or concentration.

items.name: Fog Cloud (Swamp Fane)
items.description: At initiative count 20 outdoors, while the Swamp Fane has not been reconsecrated, Strahd casts fog cloud at 5th level without components or concentration. While the fog remains, Strahd has blindsight out to its edges.
